name: Quattro Daily
author: atsokolas
description: A morning newspaper about yesterday on your machine, set from your plugins, agent work, git and the weather, and laid on your wallpaper.

barWidget.description: A folded paper on the bar, dotted when there's an edition you haven't read; the edition and back issues in the panel.

schema.label: Morning starts at
schema.description: Yesterday's edition is set at this hour, or at the first unlock after it.

schema.label: Headlines by Claude
schema.description: Asks Claude Code to rewrite the headlines from the facts. Needs claude on your PATH; sends the front page's facts to Claude.

schema.label: A copy on claude.ai
schema.description: After each edition is set, a short Claude Code session publishes it to a private claude.ai link that stays the same every day.
